[EN] Killian's Prison, Killian's Playground, Labyrinth of Terror—these are all just names for the same place.

However you dress it up, it's still a pit of evil, plain and simple. And we're here to fight it, plain and simple.
[ES] Killian's Prison, Killian's Playground, Labyrinth of Terror: todos son nombres para el mismo lugar.

Por mucho que lo adornes, sigue siendo un pozo de maldad, simple y llanamente. Y estamos aquí para combatirlo, simple y llanamente.
